name: L. H. Palmer
role: Deadwood businessman on the Medora-Black Hills route
bio: L. H. Palmer was a Deadwood businessman, described in June 1884 as owning considerable property there, who praised the Medora-Black Hills freight route; in July 1884 the Cow Boy named him among Hills freighters who called it the best route they had travelled. He served as secretary of the Republican county convention in August 1884 and of a second convention in September, and left to winter in the Hills that October.
